text:
ashley.pm: Quick thread: need a compact decision for the enterprise pilot. Scope options are: fast BYOK handshake + 90d default retention, or enterprise-grade immutable 1y logs + escrow attestation. We can't do both in Q2.

nate.eng: From eng: BYOK handshake + managed-key fallback is doable in 3 sprints. Immutable 1y needs storage redesign and index rewrite ~6-8 sprints.

radhika.sec: Security preference is immutable 1y for audit completeness. If we pick BYOK-first, require a legal-signed pilot waiver and an attestation roadmap with dates.

ashley.pm: Noted. What about per-tenant toggle so we can roll customers to 1y later?

tariq.ops: Ops: implement retention_ttl per tenant behind a feature flag. Default 90d, allow up to 365d. Migration job to backfill longer retention will run async; include a safety marker to prevent GC while job runs.

nate.eng: We also need keystore policy: BYOK or Redwood-managed. BYOK flow must support key rewraps (rotate without decrypting). That adds a nontrivial handshake but avoids data movement.

compliance-bot: Reminder: any pilot with BYOK must have a signed DPA addendum and explicit customer acceptance of pilot retention limits.

radhika.sec: Also: audit-export API as a compensating control. If customers can export raw audit streams they can maintain their own immutable archives during pilot.

ashley.pm: Proposal: ship Pilot-A (BYOK handshake + managed-key fallback + retention_ttl flag default 90d + audit-export endpoint as stretch). Legal signs waiver for pilot customers. Collect votes.

nate.eng: Vote: A. Low risk path for Q2.

radhika.sec: Conditional vote: A only if legal waiver + export API exists. Else B.

tariq.ops: Vote: A with TTL flag and rollback runbook. I'll draft runbook.

ashley.pm: Action items: Nate -> attach cost + sprint estimate (tomorrow). Tariq -> retention_ttl spec + runbook (EOD). Radhika -> legal redlines for waiver + attestation timeline. We'll reconvene Fri 09:00.
